comparator.sourceNotes: Fresh permitted revisit: the public 2026–2027 bachelor study guide identifies BSc Clinical Technology (B-KT), programme32106, 180EC, with 26 taught components totalling150EC plus the formally required30EC minor. Its current KT2755 course32312 explicitly belongs to this bachelor as well as the separate master bridge and assigns3.5EC. This is genuine current bachelor evidence, no longer merely an inference from the MSc bridge. However, the adopted BSc OER effective31August2026 still assigns KT2755 4.5EC in Appendix3, while Article7 specifies180EC overall; its printed course allocation totals181EC. Article7(4) locates course weights in the OER appendix and7(5) describes the guide as elaborating actual teaching. Under Production Instructions2.1 formal-source precedence, the catalogue is not treated as an explicit amendment to that conflicting adopted weight. The current bachelor examination rules retain the30ECminor for entrants from2024–2025 but supply no placement-credit correction or credit-sharing rule. Preserve the 27OER components as diagnostic181EC and display only the unchanged verified first-year60EC. Placement requiresKT1905/equivalent and vaccination; KT2905 requiresKT1905; KT3905 requiresKT1905 andKT2905; KTO requires all60first-yearEC plus at least53second-yearEC and project/proposal approvals. The current catalogue is accessible through its public programme and course entries; an older linked entry404 is not the academic blocker. Complete reconstruction and dependent UCR approval remain withheld pending authoritative reconciliation of current BSc sources.

audience.programmeDescription: Clinical Technology combines medicine and engineering to study the human body, disease and medical technology. The joint programme includes integrated medical and technical subjects, clinical and communication skills, design work, a healthcare placement and a research or design capstone.
